prompts.waddlepop: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one standalone game creature idle base portrait. Match the supplied Cirruskit and Critters style references: simple cute collectible monster, chunky clean near-black outlines of consistent thickness, flat color areas with only one or two crisp cel-shaded planes, no texture, no gradients, no blur. Penguin evolution line that throws snowballs/icicle bombs. Shared palette deep ocean blue, ice cyan, warm white belly, small amber beak and feet. Three-quarter view facing slightly right, both feet planted, relaxed flippers at sides, generic neutral standing pose for future animation. Center complete silhouette with generous transparent margin, square composition. Actual transparent background, no ground shadow, scenery, text, labels, projectile in flight, or action effects. Keep large readable features at 130px game size. Only ONE creature. WADDLEPOP, first evolution: tiny round baby water penguin, oversized friendly dark eyes with simple white shine, warm white oval face/belly, two tiny blue flippers, little webbed feet, one soft snowy tuft atop head. A single small round snowball-shaped white marking at the end of each flipper suggests its snowball throwing ability. Extremely simple and appealing, no armor or equipment. Reference images are style inputs only; invent a penguin, do not copy cat anatomy.
